config.selection: Highest mean validation four-class macro-F1 over all three seeds; ties use configuration order; no seed selection.
config.context: Four past-only expert-annotation timing features: previous RR seconds, past-ten mean RR seconds, previous RR / past-ten mean, previous RR / preceding RR. StandardScaler fitted to training samples only. No class labels, next RR, subject ID or record ID are model inputs.
config.test_policy: The old fixed test set has already been viewed. All twelve runs and validation selection are frozen before one final test-evaluation phase. No subsequent tuning or model selection using test results. This is exploratory reuse, not a fresh blinded or external test.
research_questions: Does square-root weighting change minority recall and false positives relative to the original inverse-frequency CE CNN?
Does focal modulation gamma=2 change the square-root-weighted CE model when weighted reduction, architecture and seeds are held constant?
Does adding past RR context improve the same focal-loss model without changing patient splits or ECG windows?
